packs.name: After hours
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Violet neon, taxi-light blue. One more track before dawn.
packs.toml:
[meta]
name = "After hours"
author = "Glowtune"
version = 1

[colors]
mode = "gradient"
background = "#0d091b"
surface = "#ffffff18"
text = "#f5edff"
accent = "#b58aff"
glow = ["#b58aff","#55cfff","#ff63b5"]

[glass]
blur = 36
opacity = 0.5
radius = 24

[font]
family = "Instrument Sans"
lyrics_family = "Bricolage Grotesque"
lyrics_size = 50

[glow]
effect = "orbit"
effect_speed = 0.7
enabled = true
thickness = 64
intensity = 1.1
beat_reactivity = 0.8
drift_speed = 1.6
corners = "rounded"
monitors = "all"

[lyrics]
style = "rise"
position = "bottom-center"
show_on_desktop = true
